notes.title: Flip Crystal League Steamdeck compatible!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Good news, Flip Crystal League is 100% playable on Steamdeck.
Now you can play it anywhere, for maximum fun!

Enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Bug fix League mode
notes.content: Fixed a small bug that could trigger when creating a new League.

notes.title: Flip Crystal League is now available!
notes.content:
Good news: Flip Crystal League is finally available!

Flip Crystal League is a spiritual descendant of Windjammers and especially Battle Flip Shot on Neo Geo. It's a 1v1 versus sports game based on the principle of Pong, with the addition of several mechanics.

Check out the game's page to find out more.

I hope you enjoy Flip Crystal League. :)
